definitions.explanation: covering or including all items, topics, or aspects without omission

examples.japanese: {全|ぜん}{分野|ぶんや}を{網羅|もうら}する。
この{辞書|じしょ}は{基本|きほん}{語彙|ごい}を{網羅|もうら}している。
examples.english: This dictionary comprehensively covers basic vocabulary.

examples.japanese: {網羅|もうら}{的|てき}な{調査|ちょうさ}を{行|おこな}った。

notes:
{網羅|もうら} implies comprehensive, exhaustive coverage of a subject or collection.

KANJI BREAKDOWN:
- {網|もう} (net, mesh)
- {羅|ら} (thin silk, gauze; to spread out)

ETYMOLOGY:
The word evokes the image of a net that catches everything - nothing escapes.

USAGE:
- {網羅|もうら}する (to cover comprehensively - suru verb)
- {網羅|もうら}{的|てき} (comprehensive, exhaustive - na-adjective)

COMMON CONTEXTS:
- {情報|じょうほう}を{網羅|もうら}する (to comprehensively cover information)
- {全|ぜん}{項目|こうもく}を{網羅|もうら}する (to cover all items)
- {網羅|もうら}{的|てき}なリスト (a comprehensive list)
